verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a Storefront API that can run on any platform (web, apps, games) and covers products, collections, cart and checkout. It also ships Hydrogen, a first-party headless framework with hosting included and "complete control over the frontend", and the Shopify CLI can scaffold headless storefronts. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building a headless/Hydrogen storefront (community items only offer general API and documentation complaints, not concrete headless failures).
